ILO: secure and fast, but no entity markup.

security.txt is published, HSTS covers subdomains, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But no page read carries JSON-LD, so the Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube profiles it links are never tied to the ILO.

Lesson: Add Organization markup with url, logo and sameAs so AI answers name you right.

One automated read of public pages on 21 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict.

Policía Nacional's search has no label.

HSTS with preload, framing limited to its own origin, a declared language, and every internal link opened answered. But the home page search box and volume slider have no label, so screen readers announce blank fields.

Lesson: Tie each field to a <label for>, or give it an aria-label. A screen reader can only announce a name that exists.

Lesson: Drop user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag, so people can zoom to at least 200%.

HSTS is on, framing is limited to the same origin, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But the start page has no viewport meta tag, so phones draw the desktop layout zoomed out, and Google indexes mobile first.

Gob.mx can be framed by any other site.

A permanent https redirect, real 404s for unknown paths, and pages that read well without JavaScript. But the start page sends no X-Frame-Options, no CSP frame-ancestors, and no HSTS, so any site can load it in a frame.

Lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in a CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN. It stops clickjacking on forms.
